conversion_grid = np.zeros( (len(z_grid), len(lm_grid)) )
halo_count_grid = np.zeros( (len(z_grid), len(lm_grid)) )

extrapolation_coeffs = []
extrapolation_indices = []

for (i, z_left) in enumerate(z_grid):
    conversion = np.load(f"./data/rfof_to_tinker_{z_left}.npy")
    halo_count = np.load(f"./data/halo_count_{z_left}.npy")
    conversion_grid[i,:] = conversion / lm_grid - 1
    
    # extrapolate first point
    conversion_grid[i,0] = 2*conversion_grid[i,1] - conversion_grid[i,2]
    halo_count_grid[i,:] = halo_count / lm_grid


    i_last = np.argmax(halo_count_grid[i,:] < 1e4)
    n_fit = min(12, i_last)
    x = lm_grid[(i_last-n_fit):i_last]
    y = conversion_grid[i,(i_last-n_fit):i_last]
    w = np.sqrt(halo_count_grid[i,(i_last-n_fit):i_last])
    a, b, c = np.polyfit(x, y, 2, w=w)
    extrapolation_indices.append(i_last)
    x0 = lm_grid[i_last]
    coeffs = [2 * a * x0 + b, c - a * x0**2]
    extrapolation_coeffs.append(coeffs)
    p = np.poly1d(coeffs)
    # conversion_grid[i,i_last:] = p(lm_grid[i_last:])
    
    if i == 0:
        plt.plot(lm_grid, conversion_grid[i,:])
        plt.axvline(lm_grid[i_last])

        plt.plot(x, y)

    return 1 / (np.exp(-p/l) + 1)

    step = sigma(np.arange(len(lm_grid)) - i_last, 1)

def get_halos_and_vol(i_z):
    z_left = z_grid[i_z]
    z_right = z_left + delta_z
    z_center = (z_left + z_right) / 2
    lm_at_z_to_resample = np.load(f"./data/log_masses_sorted_{z_left}.npy")
    vol = (lcdm.comoving_volume(z_right) - lcdm.comoving_volume(z_left)) 
    comoving_vol_Mpc3 = (vol / (u.Mpc**3) * h**3).value
    return lm_at_z_to_resample, comoving_vol_Mpc3

def get_dndm(lm, plot_logbinsize, vol):
    b = np.arange(Mmin-plot_logbinsize/2, 
                  Mmax+plot_logbinsize/2, plot_logbinsize)
    dndlogm_rfof, b = np.histogram(lm, bins=b )
    b_ctr = b + plot_logbinsize/2
    mass_bin_centers = 10**(b_ctr[:-1])
    dndlogm_rfof = dndlogm_rfof / vol / N_sims / plot_logbinsize
    dndm_to_dndlog10m =  (np.log(10) * mass_bin_centers)
    return dndlogm_rfof / dndm_to_dndlog10m

def get_dndm(lm, plot_logbinsize, vol, Mmin):
    b = np.arange(Mmin-plot_logbinsize/2, 
                  Mmax+plot_logbinsize/2, plot_logbinsize)
    dndlogm_rfof, b = np.histogram(lm, bins=b )
    b_ctr = b + plot_logbinsize/2
    mass_bin_centers = 10**(b_ctr[:-1])
    dndlogm_rfof = dndlogm_rfof / vol / plot_logbinsize
    dndm_to_dndlog10m =  (np.log(10) * mass_bin_centers)
    return dndlogm_rfof / dndm_to_dndlog10m

def get_dndm(lm, plot_logbinsize, vol, Mmin):
    b = np.arange(Mmin-plot_logbinsize/2, 
                  Mmax+plot_logbinsize/2, plot_logbinsize)
    dndlogm_rfof, b = np.histogram(lm, bins=b )
    b_ctr = b + plot_logbinsize/2
    mass_bin_centers = 10**(b_ctr[:-1])
    dndlogm_rfof = dndlogm_rfof / vol / plot_logbinsize
    dndm_to_dndlog10m =  (np.log(10) * mass_bin_centers)
    return dndlogm_rfof / dndm_to_dndlog10m

def get_dndm(lm, plot_logbinsize, vol, Mmin):
    b = np.arange(Mmin-plot_logbinsize/2, 
                  Mmax+plot_logbinsize/2, plot_logbinsize)
    dndlogm_rfof, b = np.histogram(lm, bins=b )
    b_ctr = b + plot_logbinsize/2
    mass_bin_centers = 10**(b_ctr[:-1])
    dndlogm_rfof = dndlogm_rfof / vol / plot_logbinsize
    dndm_to_dndlog10m =  (np.log(10) * mass_bin_centers)
    return dndlogm_rfof / dndm_to_dndlog10m

def get_resampled_masses(redshift, log10_m):
    data_dir = "/pscratch/sd/x/xzackli/hd/HalfDome-DataRelease/"
    conversion_grid_ex = np.load(f"{data_dir}/data/conversion_grid.npy")
    conv_z_grid = np.load(f"{data_dir}/data/conversion_grid_z.npy")
    conv_lm_grid = np.load(f"{data_dir}/data/conversion_grid_m.npy")
